--- Entry, 09:06 ET (14:06 BST) ---
Israeli and Jordanian forces intercepted an Iranian missile aimed at Aqaba.
Jordanian military reported downing three Iranian missiles; a fourth fell in a
deserted area.
(Precursor entry 08:29 ET / 13:29 BST: IDF identified missiles launched from Iran
toward Aqaba and warned of potential spillover into Israeli territory.)
Aqaba sits adjacent to the Israeli resort city of Eilat.

--- Entry, ~08:04 ET (13:04 BST) ---
Secretary of State Marco Rubio met Lebanese President Joseph Aoun in Washington DC.
State Department statement: Rubio "commended the courage of the Government of
Lebanon, under President Aoun's leadership, for their determined effort to reclaim
Lebanon's sovereignty, disarm Hezbollah and dismantle its terrorist infrastructure,
and move towards peace".
Aoun is due to meet President Trump on Tuesday — the first visit by a Lebanese head
of state since Michel Sleiman met Barack Obama in 2009.

--- Entry, 11:42 ET (16:42 BST) ---
Sen. Mark Warner (D-Virginia), top Democrat on the Senate Intelligence Committee,
on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan".
Warner said Middle East bases have been "on and off under attack" over the past five
months, since the Iran war began in February.
DIRECT QUOTE — Mark Warner: "It's remarkable in many ways that we've not had more
casualties."
Warner called the conflict "a war of choice", saying there was no imminent Iranian
threat when it began in February.
Broadcast date independently confirmed on the CBS Face the Nation page
(https://www.cbsnews.com/face-the-nation/): Sunday 19 July 2026.
